disagreements.title: 28 colour tokens share only 8 distinct value(s) in light mode
disagreements.detail:
37 colour token(s) resolve to 17 distinct light value(s). Where two names always carry the same value, a reader cannot tell which one a screen should use:
- oklch(0.99 0.004 40): --background, --overlay-foreground, --primary-foreground, --sidebar, --sidebar-primary-foreground
- oklch(1 0 0): --card, --popover
- oklch(0.965 0.008 40): --muted, --secondary
- oklch(0.4 0.16 25): --accent-foreground, --primary-deep, --sidebar-accent-foreground, --chart-2
- oklch(0.2 0.015 25): --card-foreground, --foreground, --popover-foreground, --sidebar-foreground
- oklch(0.95 0.03 25): --accent, --primary-soft, --sidebar-accent
- oklch(0.53 0.215 25): --primary, --ring, --sidebar-primary, --sidebar-ring, --chart-1
- oklch(0.91 0.012 30): --border, --input, --sidebar-border
